summary: Structural wall sections and notes are provided, including design loads, material standards, connections, masonry/foundation notes, and special-inspection references. Preliminary sheet-local concerns include a potentially conflicting soil-pressure basis, an unverified special-inspection cross-reference, and several title-block/drafting completeness issues.

drafts.title: Soil bearing values appear inconsistent
drafts.observation: The masonry and foundation notes state both an assumed allowable soil bearing capacity of 1,500 PSF and a minimum design soil pressure of 2,500 PSF to the bottom of the footing.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Note 1 states: "ASSUMED ALLOWABLE BEARING CAPACITY OF SOIL IS 1,500 PSF." Note 8 states: "MINIMUM DESIGN SOIL PRESSURE 2,500 PSF, TO BOTTOM OF FOOTING DEPTH SHOWN ON DRAWINGS."
drafts.drawing_location: Masonry and Foundation Notes, right-center of sheet, notes 1 and 8
drafts.recommendation: The structural engineer should clarify whether the 1,500 PSF value is an allowable bearing capacity and whether the 2,500 PSF value applies to a different design condition, such as lateral soil pressure or another foundation criterion. Coordinate the clarified basis with footing design and geotechnical documentation.

drafts.title: Cold-formed-steel special-inspection cross-reference requires verification
drafts.observation: The special-inspections summary identifies cold-formed steel with the reference "1705.3.4," while the sheet separately identifies light-gage steel framing and structural steel work.
drafts.drawing_evidence: The special-inspections cloud lists: "D. COLD-FORMED STEEL 1705.3.4." The light-gage steel notes identify light-gage framing and reference AISI cold-formed-steel standards.
drafts.drawing_location: Special Inspections (Structural) cloud, lower right; Light Gage Steel Notes, upper right
drafts.recommendation: Verify the printed 2015 IBC section designation and confirm that the special-inspection scope and statement cover the cold-formed-steel framing shown on this sheet. Revise the cross-reference if necessary.

drafts.title: Wall Section 2 scale notation is malformed
drafts.observation: The scale notation for Wall Section 2 omits the equals sign between the drawing scale and the indicated foot dimension.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Wall Section 1 is labeled "SCALE: 3/4\"=1'-0\""; Wall Section 2 is labeled "SCALE: 3/4\"1'-0\"."
drafts.drawing_location: Bottom detail captions for Wall Sections 1 and 2
drafts.recommendation: Correct the Wall Section 2 scale notation to state the intended scale, or label the detail not to scale if that is the design intent.

drafts.title: Revision history does not identify the revised permit-set change
drafts.observation: The sheet is labeled as a revised permit set, but the revision table contains no numbered revision, description, or date entry.
drafts.drawing_evidence: The revision table shows the headers "#," "DESCRIPTION," and "DATE" with blank rows. The bottom sheet note states "REVISED PERMIT SET 10/15/2026."
drafts.drawing_location: Revision table at upper right and bottom-right sheet border
drafts.recommendation: Populate the revision table with the applicable revision number, description, and date, or remove the revised-set notation if no revision history is intended to be shown.

drafts.title: Sheet-count field appears incomplete
drafts.observation: The title block displays the sheet identifier but the sheet-count field appears to contain only "OF 00," with no preceding sheet number.
drafts.drawing_evidence: The title block shows "PAGE # S-201.00" and separately displays "SHEET: ... OF 00"; the first sheet-count value is not populated in the visible title block.
drafts.recommendation: Complete the sheet-count field if the permit-set convention requires a sheet number followed by the total number of sheets; otherwise remove or correct the incomplete field.
